# Flexy Markets

> Flexy Markets provides information about its trading markets, account types, RTX 5 platform, trading tools, and educational resources.

This website is operated by Flexy Markets Limited. For current account conditions, service availability, and company disclosures, consult the linked pages and legal documents.

## Company and contact

- [About Flexy Markets](https://flexymarkets.com/about): Company information.
- [Contact](https://flexymarkets.com/contact): Customer support and office details.
- [Legal documents](https://flexymarkets.com/legal-documents): Agreements and disclosures.
- [Execution policy](https://flexymarkets.com/execution-policy): Order execution information.
- [Privacy policy](https://flexymarkets.com/privacy-policy): How personal information is handled.

Customer support email: support@flexymarkets.com.
Customer support phone: +44 3300 271632.

## Risk and availability

Trading involves significant risk and can result in the loss of invested capital. Product availability and account eligibility vary by jurisdiction. Read the site's legal documents and current restrictions before opening an account.
